fields.title-post: Surpass your competitors in 2026: digitalization as your secret weapon
fields.rt-blog-html:
The restaurant industry has been profoundly transformed in recent years by digitalization. In 2026, to stay ahead of your competitors, digital tools must be at the heart of your strategy. This is not simply a matter of following a trend, but rather a major opportunity to meet the expectations of today's customers, optimize your operations, and increase your profitability in order to stand out from the competition in a sector as competitive as the restaurant industry. 

Understanding new consumer behaviors

Meeting the expectations of modern customers

Consumers are increasingly demanding and are no longer satisfied with just good food. They are looking for a comprehensive, seamless experience tailored to their needs, made possible in large part by digital technology. By 2026, the use of digital technology will be firmly established in consumer habits: customers will use their smartphones to reserve a table, order online, or read reviews.

Optimize your online presence

To win over new customers and compete with your competitors, an optimized online presence has become essential. Your website needs to be modern, intuitive and compatible with smartphones and tablets. Consumers, who often use online reservation systemswill be delighted to find this option on your site. A pre-order feature to save customers time can also make all the difference. 

Exploiting social networks

Social networks also play an essential role in outperforming the competition. Instagram or TikTok can become your best allies in attracting and retaining a young, connected clientele who can eventually become spokespeople for your establishment. These platforms are the perfect tools for sharing eye-catching photos of your dishes, behind-the-scenes videos of your kitchen, or exclusive promotions that will drive engagement.

👉 Going further : 8 tips for developing your restaurant on social networks

‍

Investing in digital operations management

Optimizing internal processes

Digitizing your restaurant doesn't just mean creating an online storefront. By integrating digital tools into your internal processes, you' ll increase efficiency and reduce errors. Order management systems, for example, enable you to synchronize customer requests in the dining room with those placed online. Similarly, inventory management software can help you anticipate needs, avoid stock-outs and limit food waste.

👉 To find out more : How can you avoid cash register errors in your restaurant?

Digital payments and data mining: a winning combination

The era of cash payments is coming to an end. By 2026, offering a variety of digital payment solutions will no longer be an option but a necessity. Contactless payments, mobile wallets (Apple Pay, Google Pay), QR code payments, and dedicated apps: these technologies speed up service, reduce queues, and improve the customer experience. This is a major advantage for restaurants looking to optimize their performance, especially during peak hours.

But beyond simplifying transactions, digitalization offers a goldmine of exploitable data. By analyzing customers' buying habits, you can adjust your offers according to the most popular dishes, offer targeted promotions and even anticipate stock requirements to reduce waste. By integrating these analytical tools into your management processes, you can stay one step ahead of the competition while optimizing your profitability.

‍

Making the customer experience unforgettable through technology

Self-service order kiosks

Visit ordering terminals are an effective way of improving speed of service and customer autonomy. This has a considerable impact on customer satisfaction and pressure on staff.

"On the kiosks, customers can see in front of them an explanation of the concept, details of all the formulas, prices and products we offer at Becchi" Matthieu and Baptiste, founders of Becchi.

‍

Building customer loyalty with digital tools

Digital loyalty programs

Digitalization offers a host of opportunities for building lasting relationships with your guests. Digital loyalty programs, for example, enable you to reward your regular customers while collecting data on their habits. All this information is invaluable, enabling you to fine-tune your strategy and offer on an ongoing basis. 

Targeted communication and customer reviews

What's more, sending personalized newsletters or push notifications about promotions and special events can encourage repeat visits. Don't forget to solicit feedback from your customers after their visit. This feedback will help you improve your offer while strengthening the relationship of trust.

👉 To find out more : Loyalty: the ultimate guide to keeping your customers coming back 

‍

Train your teams for a successful digital transition

Training and support

Implementing a digitalization strategy strategy within a restaurant requires the involvement of all staff. Investing in the training of your teams is therefore essential, so that they feel comfortable enough with the new tools to make the most of them and adopt a proactive approach.

One idea would be to organize workshops to present the benefits of the technologies implemented and offer ongoing support to answer their questions. A trained and committed team will contribute directly to improving the customer experience and the success of your establishment.

‍

Projecting your restaurant into a sustainable future

Digitalization and ecology

Finally, digitalization can help you adopt more sustainable practices, a criterion to which consumers are increasingly sensitive. Management tools enable you to better control your purchases and limit waste, while online ordering solutions reduce paper use.

Promoting green initiatives

Don't let your green initiatives go unnoticed. On the contrary, don't hesitate to show that your establishment is committed to the planet via your digital channels. This will reinforce your brand image and attract environmentally conscious customers.

👉 To find out more : 8 tips to avoid food waste in the restaurant trade

In 2026, digitalization is no longer an option, but a necessity to outperform your competitors in the restaurant industry. By adopting a comprehensive digital strategy, you will not only be able to meet consumer expectations, but also ensure the growth and sustainability of your establishment.

‍

Testimonials from restaurants that have made a successful digital transition

Burgouzz

Strategies and results

Founded by influencer Valouzz, Burgouzz started out as a dark kitchen before opening several physical restaurants in Paris and Montpellier. To meet the expectations of a young, connected clientele, managers Théo and Thomas have opted for a resolutely digital approach. In particular, they have equipped their establishments with modern ordering terminals, similar to those used by the major fast-food chains. This initiative has helped to streamline the ordering process, reduce queues and improve the customer experience. Thanks to this strategy, Burgouzz grew rapidly from a dark kitchen to several physical restaurants in record time.

Lessons learned and recommendations for other restaurateurs

Burgouzz's experience underlines the importance of adapting its offer to the expectations of its target clientele. By integrating digital solutions such as ordering kiosks, restaurateurs can improve operational efficiency and offer a modern, seamless customer experience. Understanding customer needs and investing in technologies that meet those expectations are essential to staying competitive in today's market.

👉 To find out more: How Burgouzz went from a dark kitchen to 3 physical restaurants

Becchi

Strategies and results

Founded by two brothers, Baptiste and Matthieu, Becchi is a concept specializing in pinsa, a light and easily digestible variant of pizza. With two establishments located in Nation and Madeleine, they sought to optimize the customer experience, particularly in the restaurant in the Madeleine district, which is characterized by high footfall over short periods due to the presence of numerous offices nearby. To meet this challenge, they installed two order terminals. This digitalization accelerated order-taking, reducing customer waiting time and increasing the number of customers served per minute. In addition, staff were able to concentrate more on customer relations, improving the overall experience.

Lessons learned and recommendations for other restaurateurs

Becchi's experience demonstrates the importance of adopting digital solutions to improve operational efficiency and the customer experience. The integration of ordering kiosks can significantly reduce waiting times and enable staff to concentrate on higher value-added tasks, such as reception and service. It's essential for restaurateurs to choose technology partners who offer complete, integrated solutions, making day-to-day operations easier. As Baptiste points out, "We needed a partner capable of providing an all-in-one solution, and Innovorder proved to be the right choice."
